bio.text: Eric Barlow, a Republican, has represented District 23 in the Wyoming State Senate since January 2, 2023; Ballotpedia lists him as the Republican candidate for Governor of Wyoming in 2026, having won the August 18 primary.
He served in the Wyoming House of Representatives, District 3, from 2013 to 2023.
Barlow was born in Gillette, served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 1984 to 1988, and earned a doctorate of veterinary medicine from Colorado State University in 1998.
In his WyoFile election guide response, Barlow describes himself as a large-animal veterinarian and rancher who was raised on his family's ranch in Campbell County.
